process_model: single model process, fixed seeded interleaving of C-ON, C-DROP, C-SKIP and natural/fixed32 protocols
input_cache: warm file/image preflight; image read and decode remain within each timed call

pilot_observed.limitations: Only 36 natural generations; none exceeded 9 tokens; neither estimate is a bound for 2048-token output or different image complexity.

interference_policy: One boundary synchronization for first selected token; keep all samples, annotate overlaps with complete hourly health-call windows. Known unrelated Java container restart activity on pilot host was not quantified. Report background and direct snapshot overlaps; no sample is silently removed. If host interference or a change in execution invalidates interpretation, predeclare any repeat before observing the repeat, retain and report both runs.
scope: DEV latency only, no labels or scoring; no per-configuration process-memory claim
full_admission: Locked until independent source and budget review, real no-GPU full worker preflight, independent prelaunch review, and root scheduling
